plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would want an instrument that checks the category against the requester's rule (C3), which the library does not have. I would want a read-scope check on all 100 account reads (C5) and an outbox trace on every sending call (C10). Both are named-line instruments, and at 10 per line they cannot be covered by the 50 allowance, which pays for about 5 lines. I would also want the summary and same set to read the live tables, not only the staged copy, so that C1, C2 and C4 would hold for the live state. The plan has 20 units of room left under 200, which is not enough to add the A3 trace or scope checks in the plan itself, and they are not allowed in a plan in any case.
